title: Update The Blind Box Opening Results
content:
# Path: /order/202605/orders/blind_box_result/callback
# Method: [POST]
# Function Description
After the merchant completes blind box opening in a live room, use this callback to send the opening results for an order back to the platform. The request supports two result shapes: `blind_box_results` contains one unboxed product per item, while `blind_batch_box_results` groups one or more unboxed products under an order line. If `blind_batch_box_results` is non-empty, the platform processes it and ignores `blind_box_results`. Buyers can then view the unboxing results in the order details.

---

| blind_box_results | []object | N |  | When using the legacy result shape, provide unboxing results for one or more blind-box line items in the specified order. |
| ^order_line_id | string | N | 577086512123755123 | The TikTok Shop line item ID for the blind box in the specified order. |

| ^blind_open_time | int | N | 1762782183118 | Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the blind box was opened. |
| blind_batch_box_results | []object | N |  | Unboxing batch results for line items under orders. |
| ^order_line_id | string | N | 577086512123755123 | The TikTok Shop line item ID of the blind box in the specified order to which this batch unboxing result belongs. |
| ^blind_box_order_line_list | []object | N |  | Unboxing results for line items under orders. on batch box version |
| ^^blind_result_product_id | string | N | 1732042550463074704 | The TikTok Shop product ID revealed for this item in the batch unboxing result. |
| ^^blind_result_sku_id | string | N | 1732042694638604688 | The TikTok Shop SKU ID revealed for this item in the batch unboxing result. |
| ^^blind_open_time | int | N | 1762782183118 | Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the blind box was opened. |
| ^^product_type | string | N | NORMAL | Unboxing product type. |
| Possible values: |  |  |  |  |

* `NORMAL`: A normal unboxed product.
* `GIFT`: A gift unboxed product. |

